verdict.rationale: Slack documents workspace data export tools (slack-docs-22/23/35/36) but community evidence directly contradicts free, open self-service export: business customers cannot export DMs/private channels without legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval, and users question whether full multi-year history export is even feasible in practice (slack-comm-2, slack-comm-4). No evidence is provided of open/portable data formats for the export, and IRC/XMPP protocol gateways (open-standard access) were shut down (slack-comm-11), reinforcing lock-in concerns. missing for 10: documentation of open export formats, evidence of unrestricted self-service full-history export, and no contradicting community reports of export restrictions.
